bugs.title: Shadow Clone creation stalls forever on 'Preparing repository…'
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-28 (fresh sweep). Symptom: progress message stuck at first indeterminate stage, no success/error ever shown, /start works afterwards (flow died silently). Prior sweep claimed fix at commit a5037b7 (split into beginShadowCloneCreation/pollShadowCloneJob/finalizeShadowClone + cron-resumed KV clone job) — DO NOT TRUST; re-verify from current code and live behavior. Investigate in order: (1) unhandled rejection paths escaping try/catch in handleClonePatMessage / cron tick; (2) Workers request duration limits on any inline work; (3) renderInteractiveView/onProgress 429 throws. Every clone attempt must end in success OR clear error message — never silent stall. Verify end-to-end vs live GitHub API with realistic-size repo. [in_progress 2026-08-28] Re-verifying from current code: reading clone creation flow (beginShadowCloneCreation/pollShadowCloneJob/finalizeShadowClone in bot/src/github.js), the webhook handler and cron tick in bot/src/index.js, wrangler.bot-a.jsonc triggers, and the clone-job tests to confirm whether the a5037b7 mechanism actually exists and is sound, then attempting a live end-to-end creation with the session PAT. [done 2026-08-28] REPRODUCED LIVE with session PAT: ran the REAL beginShadowCloneCreation against the live GitHub API with the real 304-file ClipForge tree — repo created, one-time copy workflow dispatched, pollShadowCloneJob returned 'complete' in ~46s; then finalizeShadowClone threw 'identity is not defined' on ALL 5 retries (the bug-63 extraction left 11 references to identity.login inside finalizeShadowClone where only `login` exists). This distinct defect produces the IDENTICAL user symptom: the job never resolves — cron retries till the 10-min deadline then fails with a misleading 'verification kept failing' message, and any inline path throws the raw ReferenceError. SECOND, INDEPENDENT root cause for why the prior 'verified' sweep never reached users: wrangler.bot-a.jsonc was missing a comma after kv_namespaces when the cron trigger was added — every deploy-bots run since a5037b7 failed at 'Deploy Bot A Worker' with CommaExpected (run 33218771313 log), so the last LIVE deploy (060d56a) predates every prior-sweep fix. FIXES: identity.login→login (651-820 of github.js); comma restored in wrangler.bot-a.jsonc (parse-validated). LIVE RE-VERIFY: finalizeShadowClone rerun against the already-copied e2e repo completed cleanly (FINALIZE_OK, copiedFiles:304), e2e repo deleted afterwards. Code-verified: webhook handler is waitUntil-detached; cron sweep (1-min trigger) drives staged jobs to failCloneJob (clear error + repo cleanup) or finishCloneJob (success) — terminal-message guarantee intact. Tests 122/122.
